installCommand: (command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal) && export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo install trunk --locked
buildCommand: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && env -u NO_COLOR trunk build --release
